title: Cop30: UN accused of crackdown on Indigenous people – as it happened
summary: As the summit entered its second week, complex issues remain with anxiety growing over conference outcomesColombia will host a first international conference on the phase out of fossil fuels in April next year, according to advocates of more ambitious action to eliminate the main source of the gases that are heating the planet.The South American country, which has demonstrated strong climate leadership in recent years, is among a group of 17 nations that have joined theFossil Fuel Non-Proliferation Treaty Initiativewhich held a press conference on its plans at Cop30 on Monday.Continue reading...
